sn1.40:1.1: Evaṃ me sutam ekam samayaṃ Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati magāvane Kūṭāgāra-sālāyaṃ || || Atha kho Cūḷa-Kokanadā Pajjunnassa dhītā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ mahāvanam obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhāsi || Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā Cūḷa-Kokanadā Pajjunnassa dhītā Bhagavato santike imā gāthāyo abhāsi || ||
sn1.40:2.1: Idhāgamā vijjupabhāsavaṇṇā || Kokanadā Pajjunnassa dhītā || buddhaṃ ca dhammaṃ ca namassamānā || gāthā c-imā atthavatī abhāsi || ||
sn1.40:3.1: Bahunā pi kho taṃ vibhajeyyaṃ || pariyāyena tādiso dhammo || saṅkhittam atthaṃ lapayissāmi || yāvatā me manasā pariyattaṃ || ||
sn1.40:4.1: Pāpaṃ na kayirā vacasā manasā || kāyena vā kiñcana sabbaloke || kāme pahāya satimā sampajaño || dukkhaṃ na sevetha anatthasaṃhitan ti || || Satullapakāyika-vaggo catuttho || ||
sn1.40:5.0: Tass-uddānam || || Sabbhi Maccharinā Sādhu || Na sant-Ujjhānasaññino || Saddhā Samayo Sakalikaṃ || ubho Pajjunna-dhītaro ti || || ___________________________________________
